name: Giving and Receiving Feedback
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on giving and receiving feedback -- practice these key phrases out loud:
One thing that worked really well was...
Something to consider for next time is...
Thank you for the feedback -- that's really helpful.
Could you give me an example of what that would look like?
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
